svg.title: dice-3d D30 skin template (d30-grid-v1)
svg.desc: Paint on the "artwork" layer and export the whole page as PNG with the same aspect ratio (2048 x 2367 recommended). Hide the "guides" layer before exporting. Keep the "numbers" layer for numbers: 'in-texture', or hide it for numbers: 'overlay'. Every face is upright in its own cell; extend artwork slightly beyond the outlines to avoid seams. The dot marks the top of each label. Cell positions and the aspect ratio must not change.
